name: Console Wars
subject: Video games
tagline: Twenty questions from the arcade to the living room, from Pac-Man to Minecraft. Starts easy, ends hard.

questions.q: Which company makes the PlayStation?
questions.w: Sony launched the first PlayStation in Japan in December 1994 after a planned CD add-on for Nintendo's Super NES fell through.

questions.q: What is the name of Mario's brother?
questions.w: Luigi first appeared in the 1983 arcade game Mario Bros. as a colour-swapped second player.

questions.q: In Pac-Man, what does Pac-Man eat to turn the ghosts blue and edible?
questions.w: The four large power pellets in the corners of the maze let Pac-Man eat the ghosts for a few seconds. The fruit is only for bonus points.

questions.q: Which game about stacking falling blocks into lines was created in the Soviet Union in 1984?
questions.w: Alexey Pajitnov wrote Tetris in Moscow. Its bundling with the Game Boy in 1989 made it a worldwide hit.

questions.q: Sonic the Hedgehog was the mascot of which company?
questions.w: Sonic arrived in 1991 to give the Sega Genesis a rival to Mario, and Sega's advertising leaned hard on his speed.

questions.q: True or false: the Nintendo Wii was controlled with motion-sensing remotes.
questions.w: True. The Wii Remote, launched with the console in 2006, sensed movement and pointed at the screen, and Wii Sports came in the box.

questions.q: Which blocky building game, fully released in 2011, became the best-selling video game of all time?
questions.w: Minecraft passed 300 million copies sold. Microsoft bought its studio, Mojang, for $2.5 billion in 2014.

questions.q: What do the letters NES stand for?
questions.w: Nintendo avoided the word console for its 1985 US launch because the American games market had crashed two years earlier.

questions.q: Which 1996 game introduced Lara Croft?
questions.w: Core Design's Tomb Raider launched on the Sega Saturn, PlayStation and PC in 1996 and made Lara Croft a magazine-cover star.

questions.q: Halo: Combat Evolved launched alongside which console in 2001?
questions.w: Halo was the launch game for Microsoft's first Xbox in November 2001 and sold the console for years afterward.

questions.q: In The Legend of Zelda, what is the name of the hero you control?
questions.w: Zelda is the princess. Link is the hero in green, and Epona is his horse from Ocarina of Time onward.

questions.q: Select every handheld that Nintendo made.
questions.w: Game Boy and Nintendo DS are Nintendo's. The Game Gear was Sega's answer to the Game Boy, and the PSP was Sony's.

questions.q: Which 2004 online game had millions of players adventuring in the world of Azeroth?
questions.w: Blizzard's World of Warcraft peaked at about 12 million subscribers in 2010, a record for a subscription game.

questions.q: Grand Theft Auto: Vice City is set in a fictional version of which US city?
questions.w: Vice City is 1986 Miami, neon and all. San Andreas covers Los Angeles, San Francisco and Las Vegas, and Liberty City is New York.

questions.q: Put these consoles in order of first release, earliest first.
questions.w: The Atari 2600 arrived in 1977, the NES in 1983 in Japan, the Genesis in 1988 in Japan, and the PlayStation in 1994.

questions.q: The Sega Dreamcast launched in North America on the ninth day of the ninth month of which year?
questions.w: Sega marketed the date as 9/9/99. The Dreamcast was Sega's last console; it stopped making hardware in 2001.

questions.q: In which year did id Software release Doom?
questions.w: Doom came out in December 1993 as shareware and made the first-person shooter a genre. Wolfenstein 3D had come the year before.

questions.q: What was the code name of the Nintendo console that launched as the Wii?
questions.w: Nintendo called it Revolution until the Wii name was announced in 2006. Dolphin was the GameCube and Project Reality became the Nintendo 64.

questions.q: Which company made Street Fighter II?
questions.w: Capcom's 1991 arcade game set the template for one-on-one fighting games and sold more than six million copies on the Super NES alone.

questions.q: Which 1998 Nintendo 64 game holds the highest score of any game on the review site Metacritic?
o: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time
questions.w: Ocarina of Time sits at 99 out of 100 on Metacritic, the highest score on the site. GoldenEye 007 and Super Mario 64 are both in the high 90s.
